title: Helicopter with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- main rotor -->
  <rect x='10' y='14' width='80' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- rotor mast -->
  <rect x='48' y='18' width='4' height='12' fill='#e8a020'/>
  <!-- tail boom -->
  <rect x='62' y='42' width='34' height='7' rx='3' fill='#4a90c2'/>
  <!-- tail rotor -->
  <circle cx='94' cy='45' r='6' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points='88,49 96,62 82,62' fill='#4a90c2'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='52' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#5fb3e0'/>
  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='46' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#cdeeff'/>
  <!-- smiley face on cockpit -->
  <circle cx='51' cy='43' r='2.2' fill='#2a6a99'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='43' r='2.2' fill='#2a6a99'/>
  <path d='M51 49 Q56 55 61 49' stroke='#2a6a99' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- skids -->
  <rect x='24' y='70' width='44' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e8a020'/>
  <rect x='28' y='62' width='4' height='10' fill='#e8a020'/>
  <rect x='60' y='62' width='4' height='10' fill='#e8a020'/>
  <!-- belly stripe highlight -->
  <path d='M22 58 Q45 68 68 58' stroke='#8fd0f0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
